phases.name: Primer
phases.focus: Intro week + 2-week primer. Run off-app: programming emailed to coaches.

phases.name: Strength-Hypertrophy
phases.focus: Full Body A/B split (Tue/Thu). Three 3-week micros: 9/7/5, 9/7/5 heavier, 7/5/3. Week 3 of each micro ends on a challenge.

phases.name: Strength
phases.focus: Closes the year into Christmas. Structure TBC.

phases.name: Unilateral muscle-endurance
phases.focus: W1 unilateral testing (newcomer influx). Single-limb work, tempo, time under tension, asymmetric holds. Higher-rep muscle endurance, addressing imbalances.

phases.name: Hypertrophy
phases.focus: Aesthetic-based goals focus. Main strength movements retained as anchors.

phases.name: Primer (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Intro week + primer, mirroring the year-one entry.

phases.name: Strength-Hypertrophy (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Full Body A/B split. Three 3-week micros: 9/7/5, 9/7/5 heavier, 7/5/3. Week 3 of each micro ends on a challenge.

phases.name: Strength (cycle 2)
phases.focus: Structure TBC, mirroring Phase 3.

phases.name: Aerobic base
phases.focus: Zone 2 volume, machine efficiency, long intervals

phases.name: Threshold
phases.focus: Sustained pace work, cruise intervals

phases.name: Max aerobic power
phases.focus: Shorter, harder repeats, VO2 focus

phases.name: Mixed modal
phases.focus: Combinations, race-pace pieces, transitions

phases.name: Aerobic maintenance
phases.focus: Hold the engine, deload the intensity

phases.name: Re-base
phases.focus: Back to zone 2 volume before the next build

phases.name: Lead-in
phases.focus: Bridge week: the pre-blocks August programming.

phases.name: Block 01: Baseline
phases.focus: Signature session set in week 1, retested unchanged in week 4. ROX Strong Monday, ROX Race Friday; ROX Engine written but parked.

phases.name: Block 02
phases.focus: Builds on the baseline. Programming TBC.

phases.name: Block 03
phases.focus: Programming TBC.

phases.name: Block 04
phases.focus: Starts on the week 13 quarterly anchor (w/c 23 Nov). Holds the Melbourne race window (9 to 13 Dec).

phases.name: Block 05: Auckland prep
phases.focus: Sharpen for Auckland (4 to 7 Feb).

phases.name: Block 06: Auckland race
phases.focus: Race week, then recover and rebuild.

phases.name: Block 07: Brisbane prep
phases.focus: Build to Brisbane (31 Mar to 4 Apr).

phases.name: Block 08: Brisbane race
phases.focus: Race week, then down weeks and review.

phases.name: Off-season GPP
phases.focus: General strength and engine, technique on the eight stations.

phases.name: Rebuild
phases.focus: Four-week blocks resume toward the 27/28 season.
